title: Understanding Linear Models
text: A model is considered linear with respect to its parameters if the parameters appear linearly in the equation. This means that the parameters are not multiplied together, raised to a power, or involved in any non-linear operations.

title: Analyzing the Given Model
text: In the model \( \hat{y}=\theta_1+\theta_1**{2}x_1 \), check how the parameter \( $$\theta_1$$ \) is used. Is it linear with respect to \( $$\theta_1$$ \)?

title: Identifying Non-linear Terms
text: In the expression \( \theta_1+\theta_1**{2}x_1 \), identify which term makes the model non-linear with respect to \( $$\theta_1$$ \).

title: Conclusion on Linearity
text: If any parameter is raised to a power other than $$1$$, the model is not linear with respect to that parameter.
